name: Kerok
description: Fierce folk of the desert and jealous guardians of many of the engineering secrets of the True Giantkin, the gnomes of the Kerok Desert have long lived and thrived in the red sands and wind-carved mesas. Since fear spurred them to action over 400 years ago, they have constructed more and more elaborate star-fortresses which - more than mere copies of ancient works - boast innumerable gnomish innovations. The onset of the Potluck Plague jump-started a golden age of medicine in Kerok, with sudden advances in the fields of biology, germ theory, and mechanized prosthetics. More recently, they have established contact with the newly-emerged Gearborn, whose forms bear a striking resemblance to the more Giantkin-influenced elements of Kerok’s fortresses…
